items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: see I went on the road with Jimmy Reed in 1957, all down in Florida

ctx.x: Yeah, and “The Big Boss Man,” I think, too. But she used to be, see I went on the road with Jimmy Reed in 1957, all down in Florida, and Jimmy Reed used to drink a lot of moonshine. During this period, people were dying of drinking moonshine. So we were trying to quit Jimmy Reed from drinking. So we got this newspaper. And Jimmy Reed, when he’d get to a city, he’d get him like a gallon of this white lightning. And I mean this stuff was so strong, it would, like if you’d drink it your lips would get chapped. So,…
